ops.title: Claude 2.1.283 native addendum: stripped snapshot + --append-system-prompt honored; sdk prompts lack origin; rendered is top-level
ops.body:
Native fixtures lane (cc-sync branch cc-sync/native-fixtures @ 17135ee1371d, synthetic corpus only) adds to doc c5696d4:
- F20: After stripping every prompt_snapshot record and relinking parentUuid, `claude -p --resume <sid> --append-system-prompt <ctx>` from the destination HONORS the appended context. The answer contained the marker, the first-message label, the dst cwd and the dst auto-memory path. The native environment update was appended, exactly one native copy existed, and session_id matched. Harness `snapshot strip honors appended prompt`: 4/5 runs, then 2/2 after rewording (haiku refused the probe as injection once). --help states the appended prompt is recorded into the fresh snapshot (later plain resumes should keep it; unverified).
- F21: `claude --help` on 2.1.283 lists `-r, --resume [value]`, `--system-prompt-snapshot <on|off>` and `--append-system-prompt <prompt>`. Capability probes parse `(?m)^  (?:-[A-Za-z], )?(--[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)`.
- F22 (corrects F2/F3 shapes): `rendered` is a top-level array on non-snapshot attachment records (environment, model, date, budget_usd, total_tokens_reminder), not inside `attachment`. prompt_snapshot has no rendered. Every envelope carries `entrypoint` ("sdk-cli" under -p).
- F23: a -p user prompt has promptId, permissionMode, promptSource:"sdk", turnOrigin:"sdk" and NO `origin` key. claudenative's origin.kind-based human detection therefore classifies sdk prompts as none. Activity semantics must decide sdk prompts explicitly: they are automation entry points (headless/scripted), so they count as autonomous, not human. Interactive typed/queued prompts count as human.
- Consequence: D1 reduces to appendSystemPrompt only (delta doc 64803ab).
